name: module-worker-check-loop
goal: Prove that declared worktree checks feed bounded failures into the same provider session and persist every outcome before review.

evidence: An implementation can use the entire prompt self-check budget and still submit with a failing Phase 4 gate. Assert native verification and resume in the Git-backed worker fixture.

The worker fixture covered claims and review, but never executed a gate between provider turns. Extend the worker lifecycle for repaired and exhausted statuses. Cover provider quota events and completion receipt dispositions in their existing suites.
Committed failing fixture 21415ecf88fd3bdd31fe4348d298a7f4f337d367 rejects the declared check; the Codex cases drop provider quota facts.
The committed worker runs up to three checks, sends diagnostics into the original session, and preserves rejected completion evidence.
The unchanged Git-backed lifecycle and quota regressions pass in the same test runtime.
